records.text: Citing Business Insider, Owens said Katie Zacharia's response about her credentials did not say whether she passed the bar in any state.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Trump (Donald Trump)'s new press secretary was asked where she passed the bar. Her answer just raised more questions. It reads in a statement, Zacharia (Katie Zacharia) said she, quote, practiced international transaction law with all the appropriate credentials, end quote. ... She did not say if she had passed the bar in any state.

records.text: With this idiocracy and pretending that any of this is normal. Everybody involved, nobody, we are, this has to be a Truman Show.
